title: feat(app-shell): Automations pillar — rail grouped by object, flow meta and switch in the item header, Canvas · Variables · Runs · Problems · Debug tabs (objectui#12454)
body:
Fixes #12454
Clause-②: no
Nothing on `@object-ui/app-shell`'s package entry changes.

The Automations pillar takes the redesign of epic objectui#12446 (decisions 1, 3 and 5), on top of the layout skeleton (objectui#12459, `cf430cd`).

## What changed

- **Rail grouped by trigger object** (decision 5). `studio-design/flowGrouping.ts` is a pure function: the served flow definitions and the scope's object index in, ordered groups out. A flow is grouped under the first answer from these steps, in order: (1) its Start node's object (`config.objectName`, or `config.timeRelative.object` for a time-relative sweep); (2) the first data node of its own graph, in graph order, on one of the package's objects; (3) the first record write anywhere in it, nested regions included. A flow with none of these goes in a trailing "No object" group. Groups are sorted by label, show a count and can be folded. A search filters within the groups.
- **Rows**: a 14 px trigger glyph (bolt record-triggered, clock scheduled, pointer screen, corner arrow autolaunched), the label on one 32 px line, and a 6 px status dot: green On, grey Not running here, amber Refused, hollow ring Off. The status words are the dot's visually hidden text. The row's title gives the whole label, the trigger kind and the status words. The legend sits in the rail's footer slot.
- **Item header**: the flow's Trigger, Status, Run as and version form the header's meta. One component, `FlowMetaPills`, renders them here and in the designer's info bar, so both read the same trigger and run status (objectui#11779). The Enabled switch is 36 × 20 px. Its title begins with "Off by default · review before enabling", and a visually hidden line carries the same sentence. The full-width band has been gone since the skeleton.
- **Tab row**: Canvas, Variables, Runs, Problems (with a count pill) and Debug replace the info bar's four buttons. **Variables, Runs and Problems open as the tab's body, not as sheets**, because each is a list that reads well at the content width. Debug keeps the canvas visible, with the simulator beside it, because the simulator paints its run on the canvas. Picking a problem in the Problems body opens the Canvas tab with that element selected and revealed. The canvas stays mounted under the body sections, so pan and zoom survive a tab switch.
- **Canvas**: flush under the tabs, on the sidebar surface with a 20 px dot grid. The zoom control (−, percentage, +, fit) floats at the bottom right.

## The metadata-admin designer (FlowPreview / FlowCanvas)

The Studio look is **scoped by a provider**. `FlowPreviewChromeProvider`, exported from `FlowPreview.tsx`, carries the open section and the problem-count reporter. Under it, the preview draws no info bar and no frame. The designer does not provide it, so it keeps its info bar, its meta pills and its side panels unchanged.

The canvas restyle in `FlowCanvas.tsx` (sidebar surface, 20 px dots, zoom control bottom right) applies to both surfaces. I checked it with objectui's `verify` skill: the console preview gallery, `preview-gallery.html?only=flow`, run headless with Chromium on this branch. It showed 14 node cards, the info bar's Trigger and Status pills, Runs, Problems and Debug, the Problems panel opening beside the canvas, the zoom control, Add node, and no page errors.

## Pins kept, and one reversed as the card asks

- objectui#11665 (`StudioDesignSurface.flowCanvasChip-11665`): unchanged from origin/main and green. The header shows the flow's label, not the API name. The API name is on the label's tooltip. The canvas hint stays in the header row as a visually hidden line, which also describes the Canvas tab.
- objectui#11779 (`flowStatusTruth-11779`), objectui#11785 (`authorRefusal-11785`), objectui#11786 (`heldIncomplete-11786`), objectui#11795 (`narrowRow-11795`), objectui#12303 (the switch's read-only description and wrapper): all unchanged and green.
- objectui#11794's wrapping label is reversed, as the card's "truncating flow label" asks. `AutomationsPillar.railSearch-11794` is updated: it reads rows by test id, so a group header is never counted as a row, and it pins the one-line label with the whole name in the row's title.

## Deviation list (against `docs/design/studio-redesign/automations.html`)

1. The artboard shows an API-name chip. It is not rendered, because flowCanvasChip-11665 pins the API name to the tooltip (objectui#11665).
2. The meta keeps the `Label:` captions (`Trigger: screen · Status: On · Run as: user · v1`) instead of `Trigger · screen`, and adds Status. Seven pinned tests read the header's `Status:` pill by that text: flowStatusTruth-11779, narrowRow-11795, automationsReadOnly-11124, automationsReadOnlySelect-11546, autosaveInFlight-11204, flowRegistration-12349 and packageLessFlows-11553. Status also carries objectui#11779's rule that the header agrees with the rail.
3. There is no divider and no "more" button. The pillar has no flow action to put behind it, and an empty menu would be a dead control.
4. The group header's chevron sits after the count, not before the label. `StudioRailGroup` is the skeleton's shared component, and `StudioRail.tsx` takes additive edits only.
5. The legend is pinned in the rail's footer slot instead of following the last group. It says "Autolaunched" rather than "Subflow", because the corner arrow marks every flow started by something else: a subflow, a button or an API call. Off and Refused appear in the legend only while some flow in the rail reads that way.
6. Node cards keep today's styling: 12 px radius, 36 px tile, cyan get-record, sky loop, rose end, the raw `GET_RECORD` kind word, 240 px width. The card markup is `NodeCard` in `metadata-admin/previews/flow-canvas-parts.tsx`, outside this claim's file surface. The width is the layout engine's `NODE_W`, and the card keeps layout as the engine's.
7. The Configuration aside is unchanged. It still shows the "Configuration" eyebrow, then the metadata inspector's own "Node" header and close, and the decision's Branches table instead of outcome cards with a dashed "Add outcome". Those parts live in `inspectors/_shared.tsx` (`InspectorShell`) and `inspectors/FlowObjectListField.tsx`, outside this claim's file surface. Only the double padding is fixed (the aside's body padding gives way to the inspector's own).
8. "Add node" stays at the canvas's top right while the canvas is editable. The artboard draws no add control.
9. The Problems pill is amber for warnings and takes the destructive tint when an error is among them. The artboard draws it amber always. An error-level problem is one the server refuses.
10. The screenshots show HotCRM as `objectstack dev` serves it. That package is read-only (code-provided), so the switch is disabled and no Add node shows. The artboard draws a writable package. The artboard's PNG also renders the rail wider than 240 px, so labels truncate sooner here. The row's title gives the whole label.

## Screenshots (1280 px)

- After: `docs/design/studio-redesign/after/12454-automations-light.png`, `docs/design/studio-redesign/after/12454-automations-dark.png`. Taken from the local console (Vite on this branch) against HotCRM served by `objectstack dev` (hotcrm `63db83e`), on "Enroll Members in Campaign" with "Campaign Open?" selected.
- Before: `docs/design/studio-redesign/after/skeleton-automations-light.png` and `-dark.png` (`cf430cd`).

## Grouping measured on HotCRM, re-read

Measured on hotcrm `63db83e`, from `GET /api/v1/meta/flow?package=app.objectstack.hotcrm` on a fresh `objectstack dev`. The package now serves **26** flows, not the card's 23. The three new ones each fall under an object that already had a group, so the ten groups stand:

| Group | Count |
| --- | --- |
| Account | 2 |
| Campaign | 2 |
| Campaign Member | 2 |
| Contact | 1 |
| Contract | 3 |
| Forecast | 1 |
| Lead | 4 |
| Opportunity | 8 |
| Quote | 1 |
| Task | 2 |

`flowGrouping.test.ts` pins this over those definitions, trimmed to the keys the grouping reads and inlined in the test with the hotcrm commit named.

Every HotCRM screen flow names its record on its Start node, so **no action metadata is read**: the "action that references the flow" step has no instance to serve, and it is not built. Forecast Snapshot first queries `sys_user`, a platform object outside the package. It therefore groups under the record it writes, `crm_forecast`, as the card measured.

## Test evidence (HEAD `1de2c1d`)

- Every test in `studio-design/` that reaches the pillar, the rail, `FlowStatusDot` or the flow previews, plus `flowGrouping.test.ts` and the new `AutomationsPillar.tabs-12454.test.tsx`: `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over 30 files gives `Test Files 30 passed (30)`, `Tests 273 passed (273)`.
- Every metadata-admin flow preview and canvas test, plus the other files that name the pillar or the previews: 28 files give `Test Files 28 passed (28)`, `Tests 409 passed (409)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run build`: exit 0, dist completeness 1094 files.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the eight touched source files: exit 0, no errors.
- Ablation: one mutation per pinned behaviour, applied through `ablation-replace` (the anchor hit once, the mutation was verified on disk, and the file was restored to HEAD's blob each time). All ten legs went red:

  | Mutation | Tests that turned red |
  | --- | --- |
  | grouping's write step | flowGrouping, 3 failed |
  | the dot's status words | FlowStatusDot, 6 failed |
  | search within groups | railSearch-11794, 3 failed |
  | the row title | railSearch plus tabs-12454, 2 failed |
  | the header's canvas hint | flowCanvasChip-11665 plus packageLessFlows-11553, 4 failed |
  | the meta's Status caption | narrowRow-11795 plus flowStatusTruth-11779, 12 failed |
  | the refusal strip | authorRefusal-11785, 3 failed |
  | the held notice | heldIncomplete-11786, 2 failed |
  | the Start-node trigger write | newFlowTrigger-11788 plus flowPresets-11861, 7 failed |
  | the Problems count pill | tabs-12454, 1 failed |

- Local gates: `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-drift`, `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations` and `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs` all exit 0. The full farm is CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface.** Two test files are outside the claim's listed surface: `AutomationsPillar.railSearch-11794.test.tsx` (updated; the card names `AutomationsPillar.*` as stay-green-or-update) and the new `AutomationsPillar.tabs-12454.test.tsx`, which pins acceptance 3. No other test pinned it. `flow-canvas-parts.tsx`, `_shared.tsx` and `FlowObjectListField.tsx` were not touched (deviations 6 and 7). Restyling the node cards and the aside needs them added to a claim.
- **PM mechanism assumptions.** Measured as follows:
  1. Confirmed: the switch was already in the header actions slot.
  2. Partly falsified: the node cards are `NodeCard` in `flow-canvas-parts.tsx`, not `FlowCanvas.tsx`.
  3. Partly falsified: the aside's header is `InspectorShell` in `_shared.tsx`, and the outcomes are `FlowObjectListField`.
  4. Confirmed: `StudioRailGroup` and the `footer` slot sufficed, and `StudioRail.tsx` is untouched.
  5. Falsified, in the lighter direction: no action metadata is needed.
- **Lint.** In `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, React Compiler's `preserve-manual-memoization` warning now also reports `doCreateFlow`. The component already reported two of these at `cf430cd`, so the compiler was already skipping it. Removing this branch's line from `doCreateFlow` does not clear the new warning, and I have not found its cause. `FlowPreview.tsx` loses one `no-explicit-any`.
- **Unchanged and outside this card's surface.** HotCRM's decision nodes route by out-edge conditions, so the inspector's Branches table reads "No items yet".
